svg.title: APC hydraulic circuit – lift, zero-point release, table clamp, seating air (example)
svg.text: APC hydraulic circuit (ISO 1219-2 style) – one HPU per HMC: APC lift + zero-point release + table clamp (guide 25 §14)
Decided 2026-11-12: lift Ø50/28 at 10 MPa. Pump 4 cm³/rev + 1.5 kW charges a 4 L accumulator 10.8 (cut-in) – 11.5 MPa (cut-out). Relief 13 MPa. Clamp branches 5 MPa. Valves de-energised.
rest = pump → tank; energised = pump loads
set 0.8 s up / 0.8 s down, soft end
springs clamp 20 kN each; oil releases
Cut-in 10.8 / cut-out 11.5 MPa (0B2 → 0V5). START only if p ≥ 10.7 MPa (after release + lift still ≥ 10.0). Alarm < 10.0 MPa.
Relief 0V1 13 MPa ≥ 1.1 × 11.5; safety block 0V3 14 MPa; parts ≥ 16 MPa. Real mass 1 480 kg needs 9.40 MPa at the HPU (reserve 7 %).
Rod side if 1V3 blocks during lift: (13·1963.5 − 460·9.81)/1347.7 = 15.6 MPa ≤ 16 MPa (ISO 6020-2) – keep 0V1 at 13 MPa.
Accumulator: discharge or isolate automatically at switch-off (ISO 4413); label p0; drain before any work on the circuit.
Oil HLP 46 (or VG 32 per clamp maker), cleanliness 17/15/12; flush branches before connecting modules / rotary union.
Digital twin · values: web/apc.js defaults, guide 25 §14
